task: W4-D — CANONICAL CANCELLATION REFUND DECISION ADMISSION

scope.slice: W4-D: AUTHENTICATED CANCELLATION REFUND DECISION ADMISSION
scope.contract: Maker prepares typed refund decision admission; Maker completes WebAuthn step-up ceremony; Checker reviews preview; Checker completes distinct WebAuthn step-up ceremony; Checker approves admission; Maker executes admission via PostgresWorkforceAuthorization.runAuthorized with registrar in callback; registrar validates maker/checker separation, passkey credentials, exact scope, same-transaction consumption witness (consumed_transaction_id = pg_current_xact_id()), and atomic insertion into canonical_cancellation_refund_decision_admissions and canonical_cancellation_refund_decision_evidence with AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN_APPROVAL
scope.downstreamRefundIssuance: issue_cancellation_refund_authorization verifies durable admission provenance in canonical_cancellation_refund_decision_admissions when evidence_classification = 'AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN_APPROVAL'
scope.moneyMovement: NONE (zero provider refund execution, zero payout dispatch, zero settlement, zero wallet credit)

migration.strategy: Additive schema migration introducing workforce permission accommodation.refund_decision.admit, roles accommodation_finance_approver and accommodation_refund_preparer, tables canonical_cancellation_refund_decision_preparations and canonical_cancellation_refund_decision_admissions, check constraint expansion on canonical_cancellation_refund_decision_evidence allowing AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN_APPROVAL, routines get_cancellation_refund_decision_preview, prepare_cancellation_refund_decision, get_cancellation_refund_decision_preparation, admit_cancellation_refund_decision, get_admitted_cancellation_refund_decision, and updated issue_cancellation_refund_authorization requiring durable admission provenance for AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN_APPROVAL

ADM-01.title: Protected Packet and Access: raw SELECT denied (42501); scoped preparation and replay interfaces; replay bindings (maker, org, env, fingerprint); revoked capability denied; factors retained without re-prompting; changed-semantic replay rejected
ADM-01.evidence: Raw SELECT on canonical_cancellation_refund_decision_preparations denied with SQLSTATE 42501; narrow get_cancellation_refund_decision_preparation succeeds; exact replay succeeds with unknown/dummy factor ID without re-prompting (actual factor expiry demonstrated in separately identified frozen controls); revoked maker capability denied with PERMISSION_DENIED; changed-semantic replay and out-of-scope read access rejected with COMMAND_CONFLICT and PERMISSION_DENIED

ADM-02.title: Financial Authority Blocker Reproduction: transaction isolation with pg_blocking_pids, event conflict rejection, and duplicate prevention
ADM-02.evidence: Transaction A (fixture owner) inserts conflicting provider event state and holds attempt lock; Transaction B blocks on pg_blocking_pids behind Transaction A; Transaction A commits; Transaction B rejected deterministically with CAPTURE_AMOUNT_CONFLICT / PAYMENT_STATE_NOT_MATCHED_CAPTURE / PAYMENT_RECONCILIATION_UNRESOLVED rather than creating duplicate authorization

ADM-03.title: Dedicated Appointment Bindings & Negative Controls: FINANCIAL_CONTRACT scope enforcement and dedicated checker appointment verification in PostgreSQL
ADM-03.evidence: Appointment checks enforce FINANCIAL_CONTRACT scope in PostgreSQL; broad preparer grant alone cannot approve; expired/revoked checker grant rejected; approver exceeding max amount cap rejected; same-organization checker with wrong-reservation scope rejected; self-checking maker rejected; valid dedicated checker succeeds; repeating prepare returns existing authorization with replayed = true (idempotent retention)

ADM-04.title: Step-Up Ceremonies and Factor Audit Witnesses: dual WebAuthn ceremonies and audit trail
ADM-04.evidence: Both maker and checker complete authentic WebAuthn passkey step-up ceremonies with monotonic signature counters; internal_step_up_challenges records status = 'CONSUMED' with consumed_at timestamps; internal_action_authorizations consumed exactly once with version incremented and consumed_transaction_id = pg_current_xact_id(); internal_iam_events emitted

ADM-05.title: Readiness Check Independent of Capability Row: schema detection decoupled from catalog row
ADM-05.evidence: verifyIamCatalog detects schema via to_regclass('public.canonical_cancellation_refund_decision_admissions') IS NOT NULL; passes pre-062 before schema installed; fails when schema is installed but capability row is missing; passes post-062 with both present

ADM-06.title: Atomic Transaction Rollback, Concurrency Contention & Uncertainty Recovery: true two-caller contention observed in pg_blocking_pids, precise rejection, failure rollback and lost-ACK outcome unknown recovery
ADM-06.evidence: Two-caller contention observed blocked in pg_blocking_pids; competing distinct command rejected with REFUND_DECISION_ALREADY_ADMITTED; post-insertion rollback leaves action in APPROVED status ready for retry; injected audit failure during runAuthorized rolls back in-flight admissions and evidence rows, restoring authorization to APPROVED; dropped COMMIT acknowledgement recovered via get_admitted_cancellation_refund_decision returning replayed = true without duplicate rows

A01.title: Positive end-to-end chain: Maker prepare -> Maker passkey -> Checker preview -> Checker passkey -> Checker approve -> Maker runAuthorized -> registrar admission
A01.evidence: Full dual-custody ceremony completes; admission row inserted; decision evidence inserted with AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN_APPROVAL and permitted_issuer_role = 'encho_refund_issuer'; workforce authorization consumed and stamped with consumed_transaction_id; zero refund authorizations created by admission

A02.title: Maker self-checker and unauthorized checkers rejected
A02.evidence: Maker attempting to approve own preparation rejected with MAKER_CHECKER_CONFLICT; staff identity lacking accommodation.refund_decision.admit permission rejected with PERMISSION_DENIED

A03.title: Session & Step-Up negative controls
A03.evidence: Preparation or approval without active staff session rejected with STAFF_SESSION_REQUIRED; missing WebAuthn factor rejected with STEP_UP_REQUIRED; unknown step-up receipt ID rejected with generic error (separately executed frozen controls test missing, expired, and wrong-command factors)

A04.title: Material packet tampering after approval rejected
A04.evidence: Altering decision_ref, amount, or reason after approval alters command fingerprint, triggering COMMAND_CONFLICT or COMMAND_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH

A05.title: Canonical domain exclusions enforced at preparation preview
A05.evidence: Active uncancelled reservation rejected with RESERVATION_NOT_CANCELLED; sealed V2 reservation rejected with SEALED_V2_REVISION_EXCLUDED; approved amount exceeding captured ceiling rejected with AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_CAPTURED_CEILING; non-positive approved amount rejected at preview/schema boundary; non-INR currency rejected with CURRENCY_NOT_SUPPORTED in preview/schema constraints

A06.title: Guarded Replay and cross-maker execution denial
A06.evidence: Replaying identical command by original Maker returns stored admission with replayed = true; different maker or unauthorized staff attempting replay denied with PERMISSION_DENIED

A07.title: Concurrency: identical race convergence and competing distinct serialization with observed blocking
A07.evidence: Concurrent identical execution converges cleanly where winner inserts (replayed = false) and concurrent entrant recovers via replayed = true with identical admission and evidence IDs; competing distinct command for same reservation serializes on reservation root lock, observed blocked in pg_blocking_pids, and raises REFUND_DECISION_ALREADY_ADMITTED with rollback leaving action status in APPROVED

A08.title: Injected failure rollback restores APPROVED status and zero domain rows
A08.evidence: Simulated database failure during runAuthorized rolls back transaction; preparation record remains persisted and internal action authorization remains in APPROVED status ready for retry; zero rows persisted in admissions or evidence tables

A09.title: Lost COMMIT acknowledgement / uncertainty recovery
A09.evidence: When caller experiences network disconnection or timeout after database commits, subsequent retry finds existing admission via admitRefundDecision and guarded get_admitted_cancellation_refund_decision SQL routine returning replayed = true without re-executing authorization consumption

A10.title: Downstream issue_cancellation_refund_authorization acceptance & negative controls
A10.evidence: Calling issue_cancellation_refund_authorization with evidence_classification = 'AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN_APPROVAL' succeeds and verifies admission provenance; forged evidence without admission provenance rejected with ADMISSION_PROVENANCE_NOT_FOUND

A11.title: Immutability triggers, 16-table count equality, and identified row/counter verification
A11.evidence: Direct UPDATE or DELETE on preparations and admissions tables rejected by SQLSTATE P0001 immutability triggers; count equality verified across 16 canonical commerce tables before and after admitRefundDecision, with specific identified row/counter value equality verified on canonical_reservations, canonical_payment_attempts, canonical_payable_authorities, and selected inventory counters

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Dual custody: Maker and Checker must be distinct staff identities

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Staff session required for both preparation and approval ceremonies
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: CanonicalRefundDecisionAdmissionService requires active StaffSessionContext for both prepare and approve, raising STAFF_SESSION_REQUIRED when absent; verified in focused test A03

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Step-up WebAuthn passkey assertion required for both Maker and Checker
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Internal workforce step-up flow performs positive begin/complete ceremonies recorded in internal_workforce_passkey_ceremonies with monotonic signature counters (verified in ADM-04); unknown step-up receipt rejected in focused test A03; missing, expired, and wrong-command controls exercised in separately identified frozen controls

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Permission accommodation.refund_decision.admit required for approval and execution
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: PostgresWorkforceAuthorization.runAuthorized checks permission catalog and role grants, rejecting unauthorized staff with PERMISSION_DENIED; verified in focused test A02

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Material packet tampering after approval rejected by command fingerprint mismatch
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Canonical packet serialization includes decisionRef, decisionVersion, approvedAmountMinor, currency, and reasonCode; altering fields after approval produces mismatched SHA-256 fingerprint rejected with COMMAND_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH or COMMAND_CONFLICT; verified in focused test A04 and probe R1

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Natural canonical domain exclusions: uncancelled, sealed V2, excess amount, non-INR
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: CanonicalRefundDecisionAdmissionService.deriveCanonicalPreview validates reservation state, cancellation release version, and captured ceiling (verified in focused test A05); non-INR currency and non-positive amounts enforced at preview and schema validation boundaries

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Guarded idempotent replay returns existing admitted record with replayed = true
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: admitRefundDecision checks existing admission before runAuthorized and inside registrar; replaying identical command returns replayed = true without consuming fresh authorization; verified in focused test A06, A09, and ADM-01
admitRefundDecision validates that replaying caller matches original maker_membership_id, rejecting other staff with PERMISSION_DENIED; verified in focused test A06 and ADM-01

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Concurrent identical admissions serialize and recover safely
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Reservation root lock and workforce authorization consumption serialize concurrent callers; concurrent entrant detects existing admission on POLICY_CHANGED recovery and returns replayed = true with identical admission and evidence IDs; verified in focused test A07

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Competing distinct admissions for the same reservation rejected
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Reservation root row locking in admit_cancellation_refund_decision and existence check on canonical_cancellation_refund_decision_evidence reject competing distinct commands with REFUND_DECISION_ALREADY_ADMITTED; verified in focused test A07

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Injected execution failure leaves database clean and preserves APPROVED action state
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Transactional boundary ensures failure during runAuthorized rolls back in-flight mutations; preparation record remains persisted and internal action authorization remains APPROVED for retry; verified in focused test A08 and ADM-06

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Downstream issue_cancellation_refund_authorization verifies durable admission provenance
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Updated issue_cancellation_refund_authorization routine checks canonical_cancellation_refund_decision_admissions when evidence_classification = 'AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN_APPROVAL'; verified in focused test A10

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Zero refund authorizations created during admission
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Admissions process inserts records into canonical_cancellation_refund_decision_admissions and canonical_cancellation_refund_decision_evidence only; count(*) of canonical_cancellation_refund_authorizations remains 0; verified in focused test A01

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Preparations and admissions tables are immutable against UPDATE and DELETE
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Triggers trg_canonical_refund_decision_preparations_immutable and trg_canonical_refund_decision_admissions_immutable prevent illegal mutations; verified in focused test A11

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: External payment provider refund execution (Razorpay / Stripe)
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Out of scope for W4-D admission slice; zero payment provider API calls made

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Money movement, ledger settlement, payout dispatch, or wallet crediting
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Admission authorizes refund decision only; zero financial money movement occurs

trustBoundariesAndLimitations.humanApprovalAdmission: Refund decision admission implements dual-custody human approval with WebAuthn passkey step-up authentication. Evidence admitted via this workflow is classified AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN_APPROVAL and references durable admission provenance in canonical_cancellation_refund_decision_admissions.
trustBoundariesAndLimitations.zeroRefundAuthorizationsCreated: Admission creates decision evidence ONLY. It does NOT create a refund authorization row in canonical_cancellation_refund_authorizations. Authorizations must be issued downstream via issue_cancellation_refund_authorization by role encho_refund_issuer.
trustBoundariesAndLimitations.zeroMoneyMovement: This slice authorizes refund decisions within the canonical database only. Zero money movement, zero Razorpay/Stripe API dispatch, zero payout execution, zero wallet crediting, and zero ledger settlement occur.
trustBoundariesAndLimitations.noRemainingRefundableBalanceAccounting: This slice does not maintain a cumulative refund ledger or remaining refundable balance. Future slices must enforce partial-refund accounting before settlement.
trustBoundariesAndLimitations.publicSurface: Zero public HTTP/REST/GraphQL routes or UI elements are exposed. All functionality is internal staff service and database routines.
